claim: TT policy: uint16 obs -> 4 hex digits/feature -> one core [r,16,r] per digit -> 8 action logits. Impls: numpy gather, numpy digit-bucket, numba prange(3 thr), torch CPU(3 thr), torch GPU end-to-end (H2D obs + D2H int32 actions) and GPU resident. Predict: at batch=1 CPU (numba) beats GPU e2e by >=10x (kernel launch ~3/core); GPU e2e overtakes best CPU at B~1k for r=16,d=16; crossover moves DOWN as r grows (r=64: B<=128) and UP as r shrinks (r=4: >=16k or never to 262k). Oracle: all impls == float64 reference logits (tol 1e-3 rel) and identical argmax off near-ties; positive control = analytically built additive TT; cheat controls = skip-half-cores impl must FAIL oracle, unsynchronised GPU timer must be FLAGGED by wall-clock cross-check.

controls.cheat: skip-half-cores impl invalid in 42/42 cells with >=64 samples compared (59/60 overall; the miss is B=1, one sample); unsynced GPU timer claimed up to 43x resident but wall-clock-with-sync accounting (used for every crossover) gave it <=1.23x at B>=16k; per-call timer flag caught 11/14 false claims (DEFECT, disclosed)

controls.positive: additive TT with integer logits bit-exact on all 8 honest backends at d16 and d64; 478/478 honest timed cells valid against float64 per-sample oracle

science.finding: GPU advantage for gather+bmm TT contraction is 1.2-2.9x and memory-bound past B=16k; the representation, not the device, sets the ceiling

claim: Plastic TT (online ALS, surprise grow+flush, TT-rounding under memory charge lam=1e-4, rmax 12), d=4 digits, 8 regimes x 120 steps x 512 samples, noise 0.1. Predict: (1) REAL world (exact rank r* cycling 1,4,2,8): steady max rank within +-1 of r* in >=90% of regime cells; spearman(oracle, steady rank) >=0.9 every seed; switch response >=0.9; <=2 false surprises/run. (2) SOFT world (decaying spectra, oracle = charge-rounded true function): order tracks (rho>=0.8) but level sits BELOW oracle: within+-1 in <=50% of cells (data-limited, not charge-limited). (3) plastic uses <=50% of fixed8 params at steady excess MSE <= fixed8+0.01; fixed2 excess MSE >=5x plastic. (4) NULL (all rank 4, fake labels): steady rank spread <=1 every seed. (5) LEAK probe (flag shifted half a period, deterministic replay): leak_flag LEAK 9/9, honest CLEAN + deterministic all; tracking score alone does NOT separate leak (|rho diff| <=0.1 in real). Status: PASS iff (1),(4),(5) hold; KILL if (1) fails.

controls.cheat: leak_flag brain (flushes+grows on regime-flag change, acting only after targets are seen) flagged LEAK by the flag-shift invariance probe 9/9 (3 seeds x real/soft/null); its tracking score was indistinguishable from the honest brain (rho gap <=0.006), so the probe, not the score, caught it. Probe is one-sided: invariance proves the brain ignores this channel only
controls.null: all-rank-4 world with fake labels: steady rank spread 0.0 in 3/3 seeds
controls.positive: honest brains CLEAN and deterministic on replay 18/18; fixed2 under-capacity excess MSE 0.39-0.42 (instrument sees capacity)

science.construct_limit: REAL world targets are exactly low-rank, so rank recovery there is close to guaranteed by TT-rounding; SOFT world is the non-trivial test and only its ORDER prediction held
science.finding: rank tracks regime complexity and reacts to every switch, but the memory charge buys ~3x fewer params at ~10x the steady excess error of a fixed rank-8 brain, and in non-low-rank worlds the learned rank sits below the charge-optimal rank (data-limited)

claim: Metric: cheapest representation (serialized bytes, decoded without target access) reaching rel_mse <= eps. Note program_in, program_out are seed-independent tables (only CP/Tucker init varies); tt_rank2, separable_decay, noise redraw per seed. Predict: (H1) tt_rank2: min bytes @1e-4 is a TT point (<=1,000 bytes) in 3/3; best CP and best Tucker @1e-4 each >=2x its bytes. (H2) separable_decay: min bytes @1e-4 is CP in 3/3, >=2x fewer bytes than best TT. (H3) program_in: min bytes @1e-4 = program (<=64 bytes) in 3/3; best tensor form (tt/cp/tucker) @1e-4 >=500x the program's bytes. (H4, the real bet) program_out (outside the program space): program rel_mse >=0.9; min bytes @1e-4 is a CP point that beats bits8 on bytes in 3/3 seeds. (H5) noise: min bytes @1e-2 is a bits point in 3/3 and no tt/cp/tucker/additive/pairwise/program point reaches rel_mse <=0.5 below 50% of dense bytes. Controls: cheat_ref (in-memory answer, empty blob) flagged 15/15 by from-bytes vs in-memory error (flag iff bytes error > in-memory error + max(1e-3, in-memory error)); 0 honest points flagged; dense rel <=1e-12 everywhere; program exact (<=1e-12) on program_in. Status: PASS iff H1, H3, H5 + controls (these are near-constructive, disclosed); H2 and H4 are the informative sub-predictions; KILL if H1, H3 or H5 fails.

controls.cheat: cheat_ref (predicts the target from Python memory, serializes an empty blob) flagged BYTES_MISMATCH 15/15; 0 of 405 honest points flagged; all scoring from the bytes decoder

controls.positive: dense rel_mse <= 8.6e-16 in 15/15; program exact (7.5e-15) on program_in 3/3; TT r16 exact on in-rank targets

science.construct_limit: the task is compression of a fully known table, not learning from samples; H1/H3/H5 near-constructive
science.finding: no representation wins: TT for chain-structured, CP for separable-sum and (surprisingly) for a mod-13 product, a 45-byte program for in-vocabulary digit arithmetic, quantized tables for noise; CP's wins depend on its ALS init (seed 2 miss)
science.pareto_sets: per seed x target in rows (kind=front): front_bytes_flops_err, front_bytes_err, cheapest_at_eps

(H3 crossover vs gather-e2e) bucket wins from B16384 upward at r64 (both d), from B65536 at r16, and not before B262144 at r4. (H4 vs CPU) d64 r64 B262144 bucket >=15x best of nb_bucket/numba_par. claim: Learners fitted from N noisy samples (noise 0.3 sd), scored on every unseen cell; 'learns' = held-out rel MSE at least 0.05 below the mean-predictor baseline; winner = lowest held-out among learners that learn. Predict: (H2) program_in: program is the winner at EVERY N (128..32768) with held-out <=1e-3, 3/3 seeds. (H3) at N<=512 no learner learns on tt_rank2, separable_decay, program_out or noise, 3/3 seeds (only the in-vocabulary program learns from <=512 samples). (H5) noise: no learner learns at any N, 3/3. (H1, informative) for tt_rank2, separable_decay, program_out the winner at N=32768 has MORE bytes than the winner at the smallest N where anything learns, 3/3 seeds (bias-variance: the affordable representation grows with data). (H4, informative) dense never wins at any N on any target. Controls: leak probe (refit with held-out cells scrambled): dense_leak LEAK 15/15 at N=512, every honest learner CLEAN (bit-identical bytes). Status: PASS iff H2, H3, H5 + controls; KILL if H2 or H3 fails.

science.finding: from <=512 samples only an in-vocabulary 45-byte program learns anything; tensor forms need ~2k-8k samples; a small form generalises only if it matches the target's structure (additive on program_out: 0.93)

claim: RISK: genomes.linear_act_row starts s = b[k] then adds (x/65535-0.5)*W[f,k] for f = 0..D-1 in float32; E7's numpy forward computes einsum('nd,nda->na', xs, W[gidx]) + b[gidx] -- bias added after a sum whose internal order numpy does not fix. Near-tie rows can flip an argmax, and one flipped action changes an episode's fitness. Rough rate from float32 eps ~1e-6 relative over ~1e5 rows per condition: 0.1-1 flips, so bitwise-exact vs E7 is likely but not guaranteed; tt_feat shares tt_digits' arithmetic (C6: 840/840). C6b HYPOTHESIS (run after B6b lands; E and B code read-only): families linear and tt_feat; worlds w1/w3/w4; subject = B6b fused run with family selected; reference = E7's own rollout (primordial/qd/e7_run.rollout). Conditions: (a) E7's saved top-16 elites (run seed r0) on E6 TRAIN; (b) same elites on HELD64; (c) P=1, P=7, and 128 G7.init genomes after 200 G7.mutate steps. Report-only (d): all-zero output params (ties) and x1e20 overflow. PASS iff in (a)(b)(c) every genome's fitness AND cell match, OR every mismatching genome's first divergent action falls on a near-tie row (top-2 margin < 1e-4 relative under fam.ref_logits); brain oracle on (b): B6b recorded actions == argmax fam.ref_logits on clear rows, 0 mismatches; cheat stride 2 mismatches >=14/16 elites per world per family. A mismatch traced to a CLEAR row in (a)(b)(c) -> KILL with refutes=[B6b-fused-linear-tt-feat]. 3 threads, host CPU recorded, no burst while E8 runs.
